scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.format: prettier --write bridge/src bridge/test renderer/src/style.css scripts eslint.config.js package.json bridge/package.json bridge/tsconfig.json schema fixtures .github && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: prettier --check bridge/src bridge/test renderer/src/style.css scripts eslint.config.js package.json bridge/package.json bridge/tsconfig.json schema fixtures .github && cargo fmt --all -- --check
scripts.lint: eslint bridge/src bridge/test scripts eslint.config.js && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.smoke:ipc: npm run build && cargo build --package roonscape-renderer --example ipc-probe && node scripts/ipc-smoke.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:bridge && npm run test:fixture-launcher && npm run test:gallery-captures && cargo test --workspace && npm run smoke:ipc
